description.p: Mdow opens markdown and HTML documents in a calm, readable layout. This is the Linux build, written natively for GTK 4 and libadwaita.

ul.li: Tabs, a side-by-side split view, and a sidebar with recents, a folder tree and an outline
GitHub-flavored markdown: tables, task lists, alerts, footnotes and highlighted code
Mermaid diagrams drawn natively, without a browser engine
Live reload when a file changes on disk, find in document and a command palette
Light and dark themes, reading widths, fonts and zoom
